title: ReviewHog startup runs before the Stamphog-first dispatch
problem: Django runs these callbacks immediately in autocommit and serially inside a transaction. The code connects to Temporal before it publishes the Stamphog job. A slow Temporal service delays Stamphog. An import failure prevents its callback from running. This reverses the stated Stamphog-first flow.
suggestion: Publish the Stamphog job first. If Stamphog must gate ReviewHog, start ReviewHog from the Stamphog result. Otherwise use robust callbacks and catch deferred import failures.
cluster_issue: Two on_commit hooks registered with robust=False, so an exception in the first silently cancels the stamphog hook
